Counsel for Applicant :- Shailendra Kumar Misra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.120 of 2024, under Sections 323, 498A, 304B
Ipc and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Sangrampur, District Amethi.
3.  It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the mother-in-law has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 10.09.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9551 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9551 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering and adopting the same reasoning as contained in para 2 and 4 of the aforesaid order Kuldeep Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37163723/
1 and there being nothing against the applicant to suggest that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to any demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 19.09.2024 and the criminal history has been duly explained, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Kuldeep Tiwari be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
